group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-03: 'Okai T[au]' 371 (common surname-initial query, upper bound), 'Okai T[au] AND WWOX' 0.
group_assessment.weighting: Sponsor study, all authors employed by the sponsor. The measurements - vector genomes, transgene mRNA, graded IHC by two board-certified pathologists - carry full weight. The INTERPRETATION carries a specific, locatable deficit: the paper's safety conclusion is stated in abstract, results and discussion without once restating that every animal was under weekly systemic methylprednisolone, a fact confined to one Methods sentence. That is not a reason to doubt the numbers and it is a reason to refuse the sentence 'ICM delivery is safe with all of these AAVs' as written.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base is excluded from the public edition, so this rests on measured PubMed counts, the Methods and the declaration of interests. For common surnames the author query is an upper bound on one person's output and is recorded as such, not as a group identity.

entries.proposition: THE SAFETY STATEMENT OF THIS STUDY WAS MADE UNDER WEEKLY SYSTEMIC CORTICOSTEROID COVER, a fact that appears only in Methods and in neither the abstract, the results nor the discussion.
entries.snippet: For immunosuppression, methylprednisolone acetate (Depo-medrol, Pfizer, 20 mg/mL or 40 mg/mL) was administered intramuscularly to the femoral or gluteal muscle weekly
entries.anchor: Materials and methods, 'ICM AAV administration and CSF collection', final sentence

entries.proposition: UNDER THAT COVER THE SENSORY-GANGLION FINDING WAS ALMOST ABSENT: one ganglion in one of eleven dosed animals.
entries.snippet: Neuronal degeneration and necrosis with the presence of mononuclear cell infiltrate was detected only in a sacral DRG of one animal of the AAV5-treated group

entries.proposition: AND THE AUTHORS THEMSELVES REFUSE THE TRANSGENE-LOAD EXPLANATION on their own data, because transduction was uniformly high and pathology was not.
entries.snippet: we conclude that there is no clear evidence linking the transgene overexpression/increased vector genome transduction to the DRG findings

entries.proposition: CAPSID IS NOT A LEVER ON WHERE THIS ROUTE PUTS THE VECTOR - the authors decline to rank the four.
entries.snippet: these differences are not robust, and we could not conclude which AAV would be superior

entries.proposition: AND THE ROUTE DOES NOT REACH THE DEEP BRAIN WITH ANY OF THE FOUR CAPSIDS, which is the cost side of choosing it.
